description: This file defines command-line interface logic for a macOS application to discover gateways using the OpenClawDiscovery framework. It includes options parsing, asynchronous discovery execution, JSON output formatting, and display of discovered gateways.

classes.name: DiscoveryOptions
classes.description: Holds command-line options for the discovery process, with a static parse method.

classes.name: DiscoveryOutput
classes.description: Encodable structure representing the output of the discovery process, including nested Gateway struct.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments into a DiscoveryOptions instance.

methods.name: runDiscover
methods.description: Main asynchronous function to perform gateway discovery, handle options, and output results.
